component.name: Trawl
component.summary: Search your own files by meaning, offline

description.p: Trawl searches your local photos, screenshots, PDFs, Office documents, spreadsheets, code, videos, and audio recordings by meaning and exact words — entirely on your computer.
Trawl has no network access, no accounts, and no telemetry. Everything stays on your device.

ul.li: Off-heap SQ8 v3 vector store with ARM64 NEON SDOT acceleration on macOS and Linux ARM64
Un-truncated Quick Search results with Images and Documents prioritized ahead of Videos and Audio
Soft-wrapped Markdown and prose preview alongside JSON, CSV/Excel table, and code previews
Grid/List toggle, 17-format file-type filter, Size sort toggle, and Find similar shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+S)
Top-bar Add dropdown supporting folders and multi-select individual files, plus native Linux notifications
